name: Multi-component fit (GALFIT-like)
description: PSF-convolved Sersic / exponential / de Vaucouleurs / PSF components with a shared sky, simultaneous fit of neighbours, bulge+disk and PSF+host presets, BIC model selection, constraints, parameter errors, residual images.

params.name: model
params.label: Components
params.help: sersic = free Sersic; exp / dev = exponential / de Vaucouleurs; psf = point source; bulge+disk = de Vaucouleurs + exponential with a common centre (B/T in GF_BT); psf+sersic = point source + host galaxy (common centre); auto = lowest BIC of psf / sersic / bulge+disk (a more complex model must win by the BIC margin). decomp = automatic structure decomposition: isophote profile -> starting guesses -> sersic / bulge+disc (free-n Sersic bulge + exponential disc) / nucleus+bulge+disc fits, lowest BIC with sanity tests (see the Auto Decomposition step). bar = Ferrers bar; ring = Gaussian ring; spiral = disc with two logarithmic spiral arms; bulge+disk+bar / bulge+disk+ring = three components with a common centre; structure = bulge+disk base fit plus automatic bar / ring / spiral detection (--columns st).

params.name: neighbours
params.label: Neighbours
params.help: fit = fit the neighbouring catalog sources simultaneously (their parameters are free); mask = mask their elliptical area; ignore = leave them in the fit region.

params.name: sky
params.label: Sky
params.help: Shared sky of the fit region: fitted constant, constant + gradient plane, or fixed to 0 (image already sky-subtracted).

params.name: psf-fwhm
params.label: PSF FWHM fallback (px, 0 = field stars)
params.help: Used only when neither a PSF model (PSF model plugin, Use Model as Catalog PSF) nor a PSF image is set: > 0 Gaussian of this FWHM, 0 builds a model from the field stars.

params.name: objects
params.label: Object NUMBERs (empty = brightest)
params.help: Semicolon separated catalog NUMBERs to fit (the "Fit Selected Rows" step fills this from the catalog selection).

params.name: max-objects
params.label: Max. objects
params.help: Number of brightest catalog objects fitted when no NUMBERs are given.

params.name: max-neighbours
params.label: Max. fitted neighbours
params.help: Brightest neighbours fitted per cutout (others are masked).

params.name: neighbour-radius
params.label: Neighbour mask radius (x A_IMAGE)
params.help: Semi-axis of the masked ellipse of a neighbour in units of its A_IMAGE / B_IMAGE.

params.name: size-scale
params.label: Cutout half-size (x A_IMAGE)
params.help: Cutout half-size in units of A_IMAGE (limited by the min / max size).

params.name: min-size
params.label: Min. cutout (px)
params.help: Smallest cutout side.

params.name: max-size
params.label: Max. cutout (px)
params.help: Largest cutout side (objects larger than this are fitted in the cutout only).

params.name: rms
params.label: Background sigma (0 = measure)
params.help: Pixel noise of the sky; 0 measures it from the image.

params.name: gain
params.label: Gain e-/ADU (0 = off)
params.help: > 0 adds the Poisson noise of the model to the pixel variance.

params.name: chi2-max
params.label: Flag chi2/dof above
params.help: Fits with a larger reduced chi2 get the CHI2 flag (bit 4).

params.name: bic-margin
params.label: BIC margin (auto)
params.help: A more complex model must lower the BIC by this much to be chosen in auto mode.

params.name: max-nfev
params.label: Max. iterations
params.help: Maximum function evaluations of the least-squares fit.

params.name: montage
params.label: Montage objects
params.help: Number of objects in the data / model / residual montage plot (0 = none).

params.name: no-residual
params.label: Skip model / residual images
params.help: Do not write the full-frame model and residual images.

params.name: show-frames
params.label: Open model / residual in frames
params.help: Load the residual and model images into new frames after a fit.

params.name: config
params.label: Config file (JSON or GALFIT feedme)
params.help: Explicit components, bounds, fixed parameters, ties (equal / offset / ratio), bbox and sky for one object: a JSON file (see docs/multifit.md) or a GALFIT feedme (sersic[1-3], devauc, expdisk, gaussian, moffat, ferrer, king, nuker, edgedisk, psf, sky and truncation objects; Fourier F1.., bending B1.., rotation R0-R10 and boxy/disky C0 modifiers; constraints file G). The file names in the feedme are used for the PSF / mask / sigma image.

params.name: mask-catalog
params.label: Neighbour catalog (mask)
params.help: Config / feedme fit: catalog (TSV with X_IMAGE Y_IMAGE A_IMAGE B_IMAGE THETA_IMAGE) whose objects inside the fitted box are masked as neighbours (ellipses of Neighbour radius x A_IMAGE x B_IMAGE), except those at a fitted component.

params.name: mask-exclude
params.label: Do not mask within (px)
params.help: Catalog objects closer than this many pixels to a fitted component centre are not masked (they are the targets).

params.name: export-feedme
params.label: Also write GALFIT feedme files
params.help: Write the fitted model as GALFIT feedme files (galfit_<NUMBER>.feedme + PSF stamp, or galfit.feedme for a config fit) into <work>/multifit/galfit, so the same fit can be run or checked with GALFIT.

params.name: ad-nucleus
params.label: Nucleus (point source)
params.help: auto = fit a PSF nucleus + bulge + disc when the isophote profile shows a central excess; always; off.

params.name: ad-restarts
params.label: Extra starts per model
params.help: Extra fits per candidate model from rescaled R_e / n starts (the lowest chi2 wins); 0 = only the profile-based start.

params.name: st-features
params.label: Features to try
params.help: Bar / ring / spiral fit: which features are tried on top of the bulge+disc base model (the best by error-rescaled BIC and sanity cuts is kept). bar,ring tries a bar and a ring together too.

params.name: st-geometry
params.label: Disc geometry start
params.help: given = disc axis ratio / PA from the catalog; outer = from the second moments of the outer isophotes (use when a bar or ring dominates the inner light).
